title: Pricing Worksheet: the Amendment Charge Withheld on a Vacation Package
content:
**1.** The amendment charge withheld for a change to the travelling party on a package among the Vacation Package Products is built from the product's administration charge and the travellers it is charged for.

**2.** The administration charge per traveller is the product's amendment administration charge, that being the administration charge per traveller published against the product booked.

**3.** The travellers charged are the adults and the children shown on the package record, counted together.

**4.** The repeat-amendment loading applied to the charge is the whole of it and nothing more.

**5.** The waiver credited back against the charge is nil.

**6.** The amendment charge withheld is the administration charge per traveller multiplied by the travellers charged and by the repeat-amendment loading, less the waiver credited back, rounded to two decimal places and never less than nil. The multiplication is carried out first across all three quantities, the waiver is taken off the product of them, and the rounding falls once at the end after the figure has been held at not less than nil.

**7. Worked through on hypothetical inputs.** Take a package on the Flex Bundle Package, a product whose amendment administration charge is 35.00 USD per traveller, whose record shows 2 adults and 2 children travelling.

The administration charge per traveller is 35.00 USD. The travellers charged number 4, being 2 adults and 2 children counted together. The loading is the whole of the charge. The three multiplied together give 140.00 USD. The waiver credited back is nil, so nothing is taken off. The figure is above nil, and rounded to two decimal places the amendment charge withheld is 140.00 USD.

**8.** Were the same package to show 1 adult travelling alone, the travellers charged would number 1 and the charge withheld would be 35.00 USD.
